title: Stellar+
body:
Vanilla Plus - Fabric Edition
Optimized. Balanced. Endgame-ready.

Vanilla Plus is a lightweight, performance-focused modpack built on the Fabric modloader. Designed to stay true to the spirit of vanilla Minecraft, this pack enhances your gameplay experience with quality-of-life improvements, subtle gameplay tweaks, and sustainable endgame progression—without overwhelming you with unnecessary complexity.

✨ Key Features:
- Fabric-based for high performance and smooth gameplay, even on lower-end systems
- Vanilla-friendly additions that preserve the core mechanics while enhancing depth and immersion
- Balanced progression with long-term play in mind—enjoy a satisfying endgame without burnout
- QoL enhancements like improved HUD, better inventory management, and smarter AI
- Lightweight footprint perfect for multiplayer or single-player survival worlds
- Whether you're a veteran looking for a refined experience or a newcomer wanting to explore Minecraft’s potential without getting lost in tech trees and magic systems, Vanilla Plus is your ideal companion.
